$comment: ui-audit findings.json contract. validate-findings.cjs interprets exactly the keywords used here; keep it to that set. Every prose field is written in run-metadata.json report_language; keys, enums and fingerprints stay ASCII English.
description: Top-level array of decided records, sorted by fingerprint, one record per root cause.

oneOf.description: A deviation reproduced locally by the hunter and independently by a verifier, with promoted evidence.

fingerprint.description: ASCII identifier of the root cause, <domain>/<lens-slug>/<surface-slug>/<defect-slug>. Never contains a line number, wave, agent, severity or verdict; identical in every state.

description.description: What the user experiences, in report_language.

enum: VISUAL-AND-THEMING.md#Public page metadata and share preview
lens.description: The defect class or ordinary lens that found it. Core discipline, Universal moves and Validation rules blocks are not lenses.

label.description: The persona as the report names it.

route.description: A route such as /m/[slug], or static for repository-wide items.

state.description: The screen or component state, such as 'checkout dialog open, transfer selected'.

context.description: The context of the strongest reproduction. 'any' means the value does not change the result.

viewport.description: The viewport the strongest reproduction used, or null when the viewport does not matter.

ref.description: An expectation ref in a coverage-ledger namespace: path#anchor, PR-NN, memory:<file>#<heading>, WCAG22#<sc>, HTML#<section>, a companion block ref, sibling:<path>, RULE:<rule-id> (a SOURCES.md rule; source_kind budget, standard or platform_contract) or baseline:<baseline-id>#<capture-key> (an approved visual baseline capture; source_kind approved_baseline only).

statement.description: What should happen, quoted or paraphrased from the source, in report_language.

trace.description: Source path of the defect: one entrypoint or sink, or entrypoint, propagation..., sink.

file.description: Repository-relative path or owned artifact path.

conditions.description: Conditions under which the defect shows.

topology.description: Runtime topology of the reproduction; none only for scans. browser-in-wsl is the legacy alias of browser-in-vm.

user_perspective.description: What the persona sees and cannot do.

inputs.description: Fixture data, account keys (never values), probe config paths.

pass_if.description: The passing condition is 'value <pass_if> threshold'. A recorded failure must not satisfy it.

profile.description: Viewport, network and CPU profile, plus topology.

regression_check.description: The test or probe check that keeps it fixed.

overall.description: Never above impact, at most two levels below it, and at least one below it when reach is narrow (unless impact is polish).

also_affects.description: Further screens or contexts of the same root cause.

route.description: Another route with the same root cause.

context_summary.description: Where and when it shows there.

deliberation.description: Consults, judge rulings, escalations and fallback panels that shaped this record, copied from agent-log.json. Each id appears once per record and must exist in the agent log with a matching kind.

id.description: dlg-NN for a consult or judge, esc-NN for an escalation, fb-NN for a fallback panel.

summary.description: What was asked, who took which position and how it ended, in report_language.

oneOf.description: A credible deviation whose decisive fact needs a real device, engine, clock, network or owner. Carries no severity.

fingerprint.description: ASCII identifier of the root cause, <domain>/<lens-slug>/<surface-slug>/<defect-slug>. Never contains a line number, wave, agent, severity or verdict; identical in every state.

description.description: What the user experiences, in report_language.
